questions.question: Support or oppose always allowing a woman to obtain an abortion as a matter of choice?
Which abortion policy do you favor: never permit, permit in limited circumstances, permit other established needs, or always allow personal choice?
Should a pregnant woman be able to obtain a legal abortion if she wants it for any reason?
Do you think abortion should be legal or illegal?

(1972,1976: Still on the subject of women’s rights,)
           There has been some discussion about abortion during recent years.

records.name: UNITED STATES v. VUITCH
records.review_rationale: Sustains statute against vagueness challenge while interpreting health broadly and placing burden on prosecution.

records.name: ROE et al. v. WADE, DISTRICT ATTORNEY OF DALLAS COUNTY
records.review_rationale: Invalidates life-saving-only criminal prohibition and recognizes qualified abortion right.

records.name: DOE et al. v. BOLTON, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF GEORGIA, et al.
records.review_rationale: Invalidates hospital, committee, concurrence, and residence restrictions; sustains clinical-judgment wording.

records.name: CONNECTICUT v. MENILLO
records.review_rationale: Permits enforcement of abortion criminal prohibition against nonphysicians.

records.name: PLANNED PARENTHOOD OF CENTRAL MISSOURI et al. v. DANFORTH, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF MISSOURI, et al.
records.review_rationale: Invalidates spousal and blanket parental consent, while sustaining patient consent and viability definition; multiple provisions.

records.name: COLAUTTI, SECRETARY OF WELFARE OF PENNSYLVANIA, et al. v. FRANKLIN et al.
records.review_rationale: Invalidates viability and standard-of-care provisions for vagueness.

records.name: BELLOTTI, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF MASSACHUSETTS, et al. v. BAIRD et al.
records.review_rationale: Affirms judgment invalidating the challenged parental-consent scheme.

records.name: H. L. v. MATHESON, GOVERNOR OF UTAH, et al.
records.review_rationale: Sustains parental notice as applied to immature dependent minor; broader challenge lacks standing.

records.name: CITY OF AKRON v. AKRON CENTER FOR REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH, INC., et al.
records.review_rationale: Invalidates hospital, parental-approval, and informed-consent restrictions.

records.name: PLANNED PARENTHOOD ASSOCIATION OF KANSAS CITY, MISSOURI, INC., et al. v. ASHCROFT, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF MISSOURI, et al.
records.review_rationale: Invalidates hospitalization requirement but sustains pathology, second-physician, and consent provisions.

records.name: SIMOPOULOS v. VIRGINIA
records.review_rationale: Sustains licensed-outpatient-clinic requirement and conviction against the challenges presented.

records.name: THORNBURGH, GOVERNOR OF PENNSYLVANIA, et al. v. AMERICAN COLLEGE OF OBSTETRICIANS AND GYNECOLOGISTS et al.
records.review_rationale: Invalidates abortion regulations concerning consent, reporting, and medical-risk provisions.

records.name: WEBSTER, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF MISSOURI, et al. v. REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH SERVICES et al.
records.review_rationale: Sustains public-facility restrictions and viability-testing requirements; declines preamble issue until concretely applied.

records.name: HODGSON et al. v. MINNESOTA et al.
records.review_rationale: Invalidates two-parent notice without bypass but sustains scheme with judicial bypass.

records.name: OHIO v. AKRON CENTER FOR REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH et al.
records.review_rationale: Sustains parental-notice and bypass scheme against facial challenge.

records.name: PLANNED PARENTHOOD OF SOUTHEASTERN PENNSYLVANIA, et al. v. ROBERT P. CASEY, et al., ETC.
records.review_rationale: Reaffirms Roe core protection and invalidates spousal notice, while sustaining informed-consent, waiting, parental-consent, and most reporting provisions.

records.name: MARTIN D. LAMBERT, GALLATIN COUNTY ATTORNEY v. SUSAN WICKLUND et al.
records.review_rationale: Reverses invalidation of parental-notice bypass provision under prior precedents.

records.name: JOSEPH P. MAZUREK, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF MONTANA v. JAMES H. ARMSTRONG et al.
records.review_rationale: Reverses preliminary-injunction ruling against physician-only requirement; access merits assessed at interim stage.

records.name: DON STENBERG, ATTORNEY GENERAL OF NEBRASKA, et al. v. LEROY CARHART
records.review_rationale: Invalidates Nebraska procedure ban under constitutional abortion precedents.

records.name: ALBERTO R. GONZALES, ATTORNEY GENERAL v. LEROY CARHART, et al.
records.review_rationale: Rejects facial challenges to the federal procedure ban.

records.name: WHOLE WOMAN'S HEALTH v. HELLERSTEDT
records.review_rationale: Invalidates admitting-privileges and surgical-center requirements as undue burdens.

records.name: JUNE MEDICAL SERVICES LLC v. RUSSO
records.review_rationale: Invalidates Louisiana admitting-privileges requirement; also addresses standing.

records.name: DOBBS v. JACKSON WOMEN’S HEALTH ORGANIZATION
records.review_rationale: Overrules Roe and Casey, changing constitutional protection for abortion.
